page.layout: One page: a leather binding with a blind-tooled border, a central arched panel with a figure, and a rectangular cartouche with two lines of lettering below the figure.
page.notes: This is a blind-stamped leather cover, not a printed text page. It shows a tooled decorative border and a central arched panel with a standing figure in a hat and cloak, holding a staff or sword. The lettering in the cartouche under the figure is too worn and indistinct to read reliably. The first line appears to begin "IVSTITIA", and the second line is not legible enough to transcribe. No running text, page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The dark marks and spots are stains, not print.
